sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Debrief; gearing up for deployment and patrols.
Response call from Kitchener carpark regarding a suspicious individual inside wearing a face mask and carrying a tool bag; assistance requested to scope the area.
Heading to Kitchener carpark to scope the area.
Arrived at the response call, scoping the area.
Sweeping through the carpark starting from the top level.
After sweeping the carpark, no sign of the individual on any level.
Welfare check completed at Mid City shopping centre, 77 Convenience Store and McDonald's Queen Street, all clear.
Welfare check at Remedy Coffee, all clear.

Arrived at Aotea Square, full scope of the area; florist stands being set up for a graduation ceremony at Aotea Centre. A few street vagrants present, no concerns identified. Standby to show presence before continuing.
Arrived at the corner intersection of Albert and Victoria Street; patrolling down Albert Street with welfare checks along the way.
Check-in at the corner of Customs and Albert Street intersection, area thoroughly checked, all clear.
Check-in at Commercial Bay, full sweep with welfare checks, no issues visible. Standby to maintain presence and await response calls. Ending Alpha Route.
Check-in at bottom of Fort Street, scoping for any concerns, all clear. Standby to show presence and await response calls.
Check-in at Wilson's Carpark, full scope of the area, all clear.
Patrolling through High Street maintaining presence.
Arrived at Freyberg Place and Women's Memorial Hall, all clear.
Check-in at Chancery Square, full walkthrough, no visible concerns. Standby to show presence before continuing.
Leaving standby, continuing patrols. Welfare checks along upper High Street stores and businesses, all clear.
Arrived at HQ, Ops Phone at 6%. Standby to recharge due to low battery.
Heading back out on patrols with the Ops Phone at 23%. Patrolling up Queen Street with welfare checks along the way.
Arrived at the corner of Rutland and Queen Street intersection, welfare checks on all stores; heavy public presence at Aotea Square due to graduations.
Stopped by Nandos to use the bathroom (guard 2 unwell).
Response call from Ippondo Queen Street reporting a group of street vagrants sleeping in front of the store. Will commence patrol to the call once the second guard is available.
Arrived at Ippondo; male individual unconscious, sleeping in front of the store and unable to hear or comprehend. Standing by to allow him to become conscious.
Welfare check at Footlocker, all clear.
Arriving back at HQ due to low Ops Phone battery (14%).
Continuing patrols, maintaining presence along Queen Street.
Welfare check along Durham Street, all clear.
Arrived at High Street, welfare checks and stationing presence.
Scoped Freyberg Place and the Women's Memorial Hall, all clear.
Arrived at Chancery Square, full sweep with welfare checks on all stores, no issues to report. Standby to show presence and await response calls.
Response call from Auckland Harbour Gore reporting a panic alarm just set off.
Arrived at the location; staff advised it was a false alarm. Continuing to standby to maintain presence.
Response call from Afternoon Shift guards requiring assistance to let them into the office.
Arrived at HQ, standby to take lunch break while charging the Ops Phone and preparing for changeover to the Afternoon Shift.
No response calls during this hour.
Response call from Kathmandu reporting three suspicious individuals.

Arrived at the location; POIs had bolted out as we arrived. Incident took place on the second floor of Kathmandu; staff confirmed they recovered their belongings. Requested a photo description to build an Auror report; they will contact the manager to check the CCTV footage.
Equipment handover: 2 x Swipe Cards, 5 sets of keys, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 1 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Commencing patrols (Alpha Route). Noticed a male vagrant asleep on the sidewalk outside HQ; welfare check — he woke, is now awake and advised he was tired and resting.
Commencing welfare checks on stores heading down Queen Street towards TK Square:
Arrived at Pocket Park, welfare check on stores. Standing by watching for issues or vagrants and maintaining presence.
Leaving standby, no issues in the area.
Arrived at TK Square, welfare checks, all clear:
Full sweep of TK Square complete, no issues to report.
Arrived at lower Albert Street, welfare checks, all clear:
Arrived at the bottom of Albert Street, welfare checks, all clear:
Arrived at the corner of Albert Street / Victoria Street West, welfare checks, all clear:
Welfare checks on the above complete, no issues reported. Standing by outside Liquor City maintaining presence.
Leaving standby, no issues in the area.
Arrived at the corner of Mayoral / Wellesley Street West, welfare checks, nothing to report:
Arrived at Aotea Square, welfare checks at JFC, Auckland Town Hall, Aotea Centre, no issues to report. Standing by maintaining presence amid heavy foot traffic.
Arrived at HQ; welfare checks on Queen Street stores, no issues reported (Ops Phone at 1%):
Response call from Habits Queen Street regarding male vagrants outside smoking; assistance requested to move them along.
Arrived at Habits; advised them to move along, they complied. Standing by until they move along.

Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street / Wellesley Street East, check-in at Auckland Library, no issues. Commencing full sweep down to the corner of Lorne Street / Victoria Street East with welfare checks.
Arrived at the corner of Lorne Street / Victoria Street East, welfare checks on stores, all clear:
Arrived at Chancery Square / Freyberg Square, welfare checks on stores complete, all clear:
Full sweep of Chancery Square / Freyberg Square complete, no issues to report. Welfare checks on stores at Chancery Square, all clear:
Standing by maintaining presence for businesses still open and watching for any issues or vagrants.
Leaving standby; headed to Durham Street West, Wilson Carpark to commence a sweep as requested by Boss Hasi.
Arrived at Wilson Carpark, Durham Street West, welfare checks, nothing to report:
Full sweep of Wilson Carpark on Durham Street / Albert Street complete, no issues to report.

Outside Studio 07, noticed a male vagrant consuming alcohol in public; advised him to put it away as public drinking is prohibited. He complied. Standing by at the corner of Albert Street / Victoria Street West for presence; welfare checks at Skymart, Scrunchy Millers, Liquor City — nothing to report.
Leaving standby, no issues. Heading back to HQ for floor checks.
While heading back, noticed a male whose vehicle had broken down in the middle of Victoria Street West; assisted him to park up on the side, clear of traffic.
Arrived at HQ, commencing floor checks.
Guard has arrived, signing in and gearing up, commencing patrols.
Gearing up, commencing patrols on Darby Street.
Full sweep Darby Street; welfare check Thai Foods, Celines, Pizza Club. Noticed a male who was under investigation for sexual assault.
Received a call from Auckland Council requesting assistance with a female individual in a public area blasting loud music; en route.

Arrived at the response location — three Auckland Council guards posted next to the female. Approached her; she refused to turn down her volume and was shouting in public. Advised her many times to turn it down. Standing by until resolved.
After countless approaches, the female turned down her volume and complied. Continuing patrols.
Arrived at Bar101, standing by for any issues.
Commencing a line check at Bar101 for any alcohol.
Alcohol successfully removed from a female individual drinking in public.
Successfully removed alcohol from another female individual drinking in public.
Successfully removed alcohol from a male individual drinking in public.
Successfully removed alcohol from a female individual drinking in public.
Successfully removed alcohol from a group of individuals drinking in public.
Successfully removed alcohol from a female individual drinking in public.
Still at Bar101 maintaining presence due to heavy foot traffic.
Full sweep Bar101, all clear, no issues; patrolling up Queen Street.
Welfare check McDonald's Queen, Timezone, 77 Convenience Store, Avachi Chicken, Mid City, all clear. Standing by at McDonald's for any issues.
McDonald's Queen all clear; heading back to HQ to commence 30-minute break.
Arrived at HQ, commencing break while charging Ops Phone and responding to any calls.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.

On standby charging Ops Phone. Commencing patrol on Queen Street; welfare check at McDonald's Queen Street and 77 Convenience Store — all clear, no issues. McDonald's Queen Street is busy so remaining in the area. At Bar101 standing by as it is busy, with many patrons on Elliott Street.
Still standing by at Bar101; a few patrons who left the bar have passed out — ensuring they get safely to their rides home and offering water if required. Standing by a bit longer.
Assisting a patron into her ride; her car was parked on Queen Street so we asked for it to be brought onto Darby Street.
McDonald's Queen Street all clear, though very busy. Heading back to Bar101 as it is closing soon; Bar101 now closed, commencing patrols, no issues to report.
Wilson Carpark, Albert Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Albert Street all clear, no issues to report.
Ace Karaoke all good, no issues to report. Austin (ASG guard) on post — no issues for the night at Ace Karaoke.
Taking cover at Ace Karaoke as it is raining. Standing by.

Received a call from McDonald's Britomart about a group vaping inside; responded and reached the store at 02:41. Spoke with the group, who appeared to be minors. They were ordering food, so we warned them and are now standing by outside McDonald's Britomart. Informed the restaurant manager.
Pioneer Women's Memorial Hall area all clear, no issues; a couple of vagrants sitting under shade, no issues to report. Standing by for calls and showing presence.
McDonald's Queen Street all clear, no issues to report.
